column1: # Key for the NA 4.VEL Suriname fortification-survey cipher (Wollant, 1781). Grade C throughout: read from
# known plaintext (2007A's own interlinear gloss, written directly on the ciphered sheet, and 2061's own
# interlinear gloss; 2007B's plain twin used as supporting cross-reference for 2007A's title only).
# "Confirmed" here means the SIGN's shape was read the same way by >=2 independent transcription passes
# (either two different workers reading the same crop blind, or the same shape recurring correctly across
# two different sheets/words) AND the letter position is unambiguous given the known gloss text.
# See glyphs.md for the full shape atlas, occurrence list and every open disagreement; conflicts.tsv for
# signs deliberately left OUT of this file because two readings disagreed.
